sources.description: The ESA's Euclid has already teased us with some early results. Those images showed individual targets from the Horsehead Nebula to the Perseus cluster of galaxies.

sources.title: Euclid's First Data Release: A Stepping Stone to its 3D Map of the Sky
sources.description: The ESA's Euclid Space Telescope has released its first huge batch of data. It's all part of the telescope's mission to study dark energy and dark matter. The telescope is busy creating the largest ever 3D map of the Universe with its huge 600 megapixel camera, and new images give us some highlights.
